title: A party after hours and the Woodside Hotel
summary: After one all-night party they went back to the Woodside Hotel, where Basie wrote 'Jumpin' at the Woodside'.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I met up with a...I can't think of the gentleman's name... was a white fellow. He had a whole flat. Everything goin' on there. So, he invited me up...to go with him one night after we got through. So we went by. Everything was on the house. We had a good time. We played the... Pete played the piano. We had a helluva time there. We stayed up there till run near twelve o'clock the next day. So we stayed so long, say, "Well, you-all can go to sleep now." Instead of us goin' to the hotel. We was all livin' at the Woodside Hotel in New York City. That's when Count Basie wrote his number..."One O'...the "Woodside Jump" or somethin'.

"Jumpin' At The Woodside." So, uh, they send our clothes out to get 'em pressed and clean. So we stayed there that night...that day, rather, and we left right from there and went on right back to work that night. After that, we got...we used to go up there every night...every mornin', rather and hang around. All the movie stars hung around up there. I met a lot of movie stars.
